settings.heading: Made for the slow, strong hour
Move with us
settings.text:
Stilla began as a small pilates studio with a simple wish: clothes that disappear while you move. Today we design a short, considered range of activewear in a handful of colours that work together.

Everything is knitted in Portugal from recycled yarns, tested in our own classes and made to last for years rather than seasons.

settings.heading: The Sculpt fabric
settings.text: A dense, matte knit that holds without squeezing. Squat-proof, quick to dry and soft enough to wear all day. Our tights, shorts and long sleeves are all cut from it.

settings.heading: Outdoor sessions
settings.text: Every Sunday from May to September we roll out the mats in the park. Bring a friend, borrow a mat, stay for coffee. Sign up to the letter below to get the dates.

settings.quote: “The first tights I forget I am wearing. Two years in and they still look new.”

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders leave our warehouse within one working day. Delivery in the Nordics takes 1–3 days, the rest of the EU 3–6 days.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange?
settings.answer: Yes, within 30 days if the item is unworn and the tags are on. Exchanges for another size are free.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Each product page has a size question form. Tell us your usual size and height and we reply within a day.

settings.question: How should I wash Stilla pieces?
settings.answer: Wash at 30 °C inside out, no fabric softener, and let them dry flat. They will keep their shape for years.

settings.question: What do you do with my email?
settings.answer: We use it only to send the newsletter or answer your question. You can unsubscribe from every letter.

settings.heading: Sign up for our newsletter
settings.note: By signing up you agree to our privacy policy. One letter a month, unsubscribe any time.
